primary_question: Does the funding + price-dislocation feature set improve out-of-sample forecasts of a SIGNED-JUMP / SEMIVARIANCE-ASYMMETRY tail event beyond an RV-only baseline on the broad ironflow_bulk panel, clearing a frozen 2% materiality floor with Holm-adjusted uncertainty, WHEN the jump ESTIMATOR (bipower vs threshold-bipower) AND the forecast HORIZON ({24h, 48h}) are varied and ALL FCLR-POOLED-AUDIT-001 leakage remediations are applied simultaneously (48h purge+embargo, NON-overlapping forward-outcome windows, mark/index tolerance filter, delisting-aware per-coin identity, per-coin cluster bootstrap, Holm across the declared estimator x horizon x metric family)?

design.forecast_origin: per-coin NON-OVERLAPPING origins spaced >= H hours (close of hour t), H in {24, 48}
design.target: jump event y_t = 1 if J^{(H)}_{t+1..t+H} > q_t
design.jump_definition: J^{(H)} = sign(RS+ - RS-) * (RV_H - BV_H); RV_H = sum of squared 1h log returns over next H hours; BV_H = bipower variation (bipower OR threshold-bipower with a 3-sigma expanding threshold on the later return of each pair); RS+/RS- = realized semivariance of positive/negative returns over the same H-hour window
design.quantile_q_t: expanding, TRAIN-ONLY per-coin high quantile (0.95) of trailing signed-jump magnitude |J^{(H)}|, shifted by 1 (no future information)
design.candidate: RV + signed funding_rate + abs(funding_rate) + premium + mark/EMA24 distance
remediations_applied: Holm across the declared estimator x horizon x metric family
inference: Holm step-down over the declared (estimator x horizon x metric) family

materiality_definition: candidate relative Brier (or log-loss) improvement over the RV-only baseline must exceed 0.02 (2%) in at least one estimator x horizon config with Holm-adjusted significance; verdict is symmetric PROMOTED / NOT_SUPPORTED; a null that survives across ALL estimators and horizons is a valid, publishable negative result that closes the volatility-jump arm for good

verdict_rule.PROMOTED: materiality_met is True AND candidate beats baseline on Brier with Holm-adjusted significance
verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: materiality floor not met in any config (valid, publishable negative result; closes the volatility-jump arm for good)

universe: coins present in candles_1h AND funding AND open_interest (intersection), delisting-aware, with sufficient trailing history for train-only quantile and mark/index tolerance
frozen_inputs_note: ironflow_bulk 18 monthly parquet per dataset; sha256-asserted; read-only; bounds 2025-05 .. 2026-10
distinct_from_prior: Materially different multi-ESTIMATOR x multi-HORIZON robustness study of the closed FCLR-VOL-JUMP-01/02 signed-jump null. It varies the jump estimator (bipower vs threshold-bipower) and the forecast horizon ({24h, 48h}) simultaneously under the SAME full leakage-hardened pipeline; NOT a relabel or re-run of jump01/jump02, mean-QLIKE, correction-time, or total-variance tail-exceedance endpoints.
